LU
((shocked))
Yeah, yeah.  Just a bit tired.

MIKE
Yeah, me, too.  Let’s get some rest.

MUSIC (”LU’S SONG”)

(Meg and Tom reach Lu on stage while she sings)

LIGHTS OUT.

Scene V
Lu is on the phone with her shrink, Aaron. 
Meg is beside Lu on stage, listening in on the conversation and interacting with Lu. It’s not clear if Aaron can actually listen to what Meg says, because he refers only to Lu.

LIGHTS UP ON: LU, MEG AND AARON.


LU
...and that’s it, doctor. Now I feel really confused. And upset. And desperate. 

AARON
Ok, I see. Now, settle down. We’ll go through all of this together and make heaven out of hell of it.

MEG
Heaven out of hell? That’s impossible, sugar. We are in hell, and we simply belong here, like fish in water: there’s no way out.  

LU
I.. I really fear I can’t make it, doctor. Not alone.

MEG
You’re not alone. You have me! 

LU
Well, that’s not saying much. Sugar.

MEG
Hey, you think you deserve better? A charming, lovely, attentive husband that will give you a 10-carat gold ring and three cute children? ‘Cause that’s never gonna happen. 

AARON
You shouldn’t think like that.  There is nothing man is not capable of attaining.

LU
I... I wouldn’t know.  I guess she’s right, I’ve failed at everything.  I don’t know what real happiness is...

MEG
Notice how he mentions there is nothing “man” is not capable of attaining.  Maybe you should go over to his  place, take your pants down and show him what you really have down there, ‘cause he seems to think it’s a tiny tail with two hairy meatballs...

AARON
What do you think is real happiness, then?

LU
I think.. I was persuaded that joy is just... satisfaction. You know, when you get to put all the pieces together. 

MEG
All the pieces... They will tear apart soon, there’s nothing you can do to avoid it, and you know that. 

LU
Yes I know. That’s why I no longer see it that way. Satisfaction is just an illusion.

MEG
Happiness is an illusion as well.

LU
If it is, it’s a better one, though.

MEG
You make me laugh. You really wanna live an illusion? You really wanna... live?

LU
I’m not so sure.

AARON
Why are you saying this?

LU
Because... sometimes I think I’d better let it go.

MEG
Amen. 

LU
((almost whispering))
Let it all just go. Fall apart. 

MEG
Now we’re talking. 

LU
On the other hand...

MEG
Which hand? There’s no other hand.

LU
On the other hand... I still don’t feel like giving up. 

AARON
So, this means there’s still something you want to live for.  This is good.  This is what you should concentrate on.  Don’t listen to the negative voice, listen to your heart.

MEG
This guy doesn’t know what he’s talking about. Listen to me.  I know you.  What does he know, with his stupid diplomas?  You should let it all just go.  There’s no point in living.  It’s just disappointments after disappointments.

LU
I ... don’t know.

AARON
Of course you do.  This is the moment to be strong.  You know what you want, you simply don’t know how to get it.  Don’t listen to anyone, only to your heart.  What does it tell you?

MEG
As if your heart could talk...  Can you believe this guy, and the shit he comes up with?

LU
Well, I think it’s saying I’m sad...

MEG
Of course.

AARON
Yes, go on...

LU
But also that there is hope. I mean, with Robert, even if things didn’t end well, we still had a lot of good times together.  I’m sure if I put in greater effort, I could find someone.

AARON
See?  That’s good.  You need to get more positive energy and positive thinking like this.

MEG
Good times?  Are you amnesiac?  Were you living in a fantasy world?  There were no good times with Robert...

LU
Yes, there were good times with Robert.  Now I remember.  We both took time off from our jobs together and went backpacking in Egypt and Israel for a month, visiting the pyramids and Jerusalem, climbing Mount Sinai...  And all the exotic foods and disgusting hostels... 
((starting to have tears run down her cheeks))
The heat, it was so hot, and the sex... how could he have been gay?  The sex was so amazing!

MEG
Well, he certainly didn’t think it was that amazing...

AARON
Now, don’t think about what he became. Think about what he was.  And what you had, and how much you enjoyed it. And think that there are seven billion people on this earth, so the chances of you finding someone as good, if not much better, than Robert, are great. Amazing, I would say.

MEG
Jesus Christ, this guy is the cheesiest ass I’ve ever heard!  
((taking a mimicking voice))
“Life is amazing and wonderful”, yeah right!

LU
I know. But I don’t feel like looking for men, now. Robert was lovely, but it wouldn’t have worked with him, not for long, anyway, because of me.

MEG
‘Course it was because of you. It’s even surprising he resisted so long with you without killing you, or killing himself, or both.

LU
((remembering))
You know, doctor, once... once he asked me to have a baby.

MEG
He wanted a baby from you? This is just insane.

LU
Yes, that was insane.

AARON
Why?

LU
((giggling nervously))
Well, that’s pretty clear, doctor. I mean... it’s understood.
(silence)

AARON
...I’m still waiting for the answer. 

LU
Because... because I have no time for babies! You know, my job, it’s fucking tough. I need to stay focused, if I want to succeed. And all my colleagues who got pregnant even only once, well, they lost any chance of a career. You know how it works.. you leave the job for a few months, then you get back and you have to get on track as soon as you can, but you’ll never make it, because you have a baby now, and you have to think of him, you know, like 24/7... night and day, and you can’t even get to sleep properly! And then, a younger and prettier and thinner, smarter girl than you, arrives at the office, and your boss likes her, of course he does, and she’s eager, she really is. And one day, she gets the position you’ve been aiming, for, like, five years. And then, it’s over. You are over.

MEG
((a bit confused))
Yes. You are over.

AARON
So, this is how you really feel like? You don’t wanna have children because of your career. Is that correct?

LU
((confused))
Yes... It is. At least, it was. But I don’t know, maybe I was wrong, doctor.

AARON
We’ll sort it out. 

MEG
We’ll never sort it out. This girl is helpless.

AARON
As far as I know, you are supposed to be a good sales manager, right?

LU
The best.

MEG
Yes. She could sell you a pound of elephant shit, if she wanted to.

AARON
How do you feel about it?

LU
Well, I guess I’m proud. I’m satisfied. When I get my targets, I feel good. I feel smart. Successful.

AARON
Happiness?

MEG
Happiness is an illusion.

LU
No... it’s not about happiness. It’s more about... fulfillment, maybe. 

MEG
It’s more about greed. 

LU
Yes, maybe it’s more about greed, if you know what I mean.

AARON
You say ‘greed’. Is it greed, that makes you choose career over family? 

LU
I don’t know. I choose what makes me feel good. Being successful does it. About family... I don’t know. But I haven’t tried, because, as I said, once you have a baby, there’s no turning back. And, after all, that’s why men do the same. 

AARON
What do men do?

LU
Usually, they choose career over family.

AARON
What makes you think men are right?

LU
They succeed. 

AARON
And if they succeed, they are good people, then?

LU
((thinking))
Well, actually, they are a bunch of assholes, doctor.

MEG
Look who’s talking...

LU
((to Meg))
What do you mean? I’m an asshole, too? 

MEG
Of course you are an asshole.  But being an asshole is a great goal for you, the best thing you can aim for.  You shouldn’t be offended, but flattered. Asshole.

AARON
Do you really think you are an asshole, Lu?

LU
I don’t wanna be an asshole, but maybe I am.  After all, my job requires a certain amount of ... assholeness. I fool so many people, everyday... that maybe in the end I fooled myself.

AARON
What did you fool yourself into?

MEG
How many more questions till we reach the million dollar question?

LU
((a pause, thinking))
I don’t know.  Into thinking that I had found the right path...  The right job, the right lifestyle...

MEG
The right cocks...

LU
No, that’s the only thing I never felt secure about.

AARON
Are you talking about men?

MEG
Men.. Cocks... what’s the difference?

LU
I’m talking about relationships. After Robert, none meant anything to me. And I didn’t mean anything to them, either. Probably they had their own Robert, too, and I was just an insignificant piece of dust that came afterwards.

AARON
What do you mean, they had their own Robert?

LU
No one considers me the lost love of their life. Even Robert.  He may have for a while... but not anymore...

AARON
How does this make you feel?

MEG
Amazing.

LU
Useless.

MEG
Amazingly useless.

LU
I feel desperation.  I see people everywhere, who made a mark on the world, or at least in someone’s life.  I have nothing. I AM nothing.  If I die tomorrow...

MEG
Don’t be so optimistic..

LU
If I die tomorrow, no one will remember me, because I’ve had no meaningful impact on anyone’s life.

MEG
You mean, besides the amazing stuff you sold them?

AARON
Don’t be so hard on yourself. You are making progress, you are aware of your problems now. That is the first step to make a change. 

LU
((starting to hope))
A.. A change? (Whispering to herself) A change..

MEG
A change? Well, of course, I guess if you really put yourself to it, you could aim to become way worse than this, actually. With my help...

LU
((cutting her off))
With your help? How can you help me? It looks to me like you are the one who’s trying to bring me further down. You know? Maybe I don’t need you at all. This time I want to make a real change - and that can’t be done with you around.

MEG
((aggressive))
It’s too late for that! Robert’s gone, everybody’s gone, you are all alone now. A stupid, insignificant, lonely girl living her meaningless life.  You say you want a change, you don’t want to be alone.  But I’m the only one you have, if you get rid of me you will be truly alone. 

LU
You are the one that brings loneliness in my life.  You drain me of energy, of everything.  Because of you I have no will to enjoy life.

MEG
Of course you have no will.  What is there to enjoy?  You’ve lived it all, you know how it is, that’s why I’m here, because you know that and you wanted me to be here.  Because I’m like you, and you’re like me.

LU
You’re right, I am like you.  And that’s exactly what I’m going to try to change.  I despise the image I see in the mirror, that image that looks like you.  I despise you.  That image, it ain’t me. It may be what I’ve become, but not what I wanna be.

AARON
You can be whoever you want to be.  

LU
I just don’t wanna be alone.

AARON
You don’t have to.

MEG
((getting closer to Lu, friendly))
You’re not: I’m here.

LU
((she doesn’t react to Meg))
Yes, I don’t have to.

MEG
((starting to be nervous))
I’m here! Can’t you see me? I’m right here!

LU
((still no reaction to Meg, like she wasn’t there))
Doctor, I think... (relieved) I think I can see a way out, now.

MEG
((backing away))
Out?

LU
Out.
(Meg leaves)

AARON
That is excellent, my dear!

LU
Yes doctor I feel... so much better already! And I’m starting to see new possibilities now... Such many things I can do! 

AARON
((very satisfied))
Oh, you can say it loud and clear! Your life is at your own disposal, Lu. You and only you detain the rights and the will to make it exactly the way you want it to be. By accepting yourself and your feelings, you proved to be way stronger than you thought you were. Can’t you see how amazing and unique you are?

LU
((almost thrilled))
Yes Doctor! I think I can! There is nothing wrong with me, after all. The only thing I did wrong was being ashamed of myself, pretending to be someone else. I tried so hard to be who somebody else wanted me to be... oh, how stupid of me! 

AARON
((smiling))
You really can’t help to blame yourself, can you? I’m just kidding, my dear. Actually, I’m so happy for you... I read your relief in your voice and feel your positive energies coming out again! This is by far the best result we could get together! (getting more and more excited) And believe me: this is only the beginning of an amazing brand new path! By admitting your fragility, you found the key to your soul. Soon you’ll be able to make decisions about everything you really care about in your life. And I’m talking about... everything! Your job, your passions, your friends, too! And of course, men. The past is past, and you learnt the lesson. No more regrets, no more guilt: you are going to find the companion you deserve and then...   

BLAKE
((entering))
No, no, no. I’m sorry to interrupt you again, but this is all wrong. Wrong!

AARON
((to Blake))
What the hell.. Oh my gosh. This is unacceptable! What do you want now? And who let you in, anyway??

LU
((confused))
What’s going on, Doctor? 

AARON
((to Lu))
Oh.. Nothing, nothing my dear.. Don’t pay attention...

BLAKE
You’re right, you shouldn’t be paying attention, because what I’m about to say will scare the bejesus out of you!  Now, this lame, sorry excuse for a doctor depicted quite a rosy road for yourself, Lu, but I must say, if the road is rose, then rose is the new black, because black indeed is the path in front of you. I already can see the wrinkles on your face, my dear.  You see them, too, in the mirror, every morning, more and more coming everyday. They depress you. Cloud your mind. Pollute it. How in the hell are you going to find a man, you ask yourself everyday. And if you can’t find a man, how are you going to find a good man? You can’t. You won’t.  I’m sorry, but there is no hope for you. No sequel. No second change. All I can see in your future is a rope, the snap of a neck, and then the light at the end of the tunnel.

AARON
Wow, that’s harsh.  Why would you say such a thing?  She’s made terrific prog.. 

BLAKE
((cuts off Aaron))
My dear Doctor, what saddens me is that her inevitable fate is your fault. You fed her your useless crap for so long, and now she has absolutely no chance of making it. Did you really believe she could build up a new life on that kind of fundaments? On her fragility? Ah! If you only had let me complete my analysis before! Maybe this could have been different. But now it’s just... too late. 

LU
((desperately))
I don’t understand what’s going on...

BLAKE
I wouldn’t expect you to, Lu. Crazy desperate people never understand what’s going on...

BLAKY
((entering))
Wait a minute, wait a minute, this is all nice, but you guys aren’t quite there yet. Your analyses are both incomplete.  Let me tell you the one crucial, most important element you are missing...

BLAKE & AARON
((they look at each other and nod))
NO!!!!

BLAKY
((surprised))
...Pardon??

AARON
((extracting the remote from his pocket))
I’m really sorry, but we are simply out of time. 
(Blaky tries to react, but Aaron pushes the button)

LIGHTS OUT.


THE END. 

	.
.

((Scene opens with Jean opening a bag of peanuts))

JEAN
I’m so tired, I’m gonna try and take a little nap, it’ll make the flight go faster...

FRANCOIS
Alright, good luck.
A loud announcement comes on, waking up Jean just as he had fallen asleep

ANNOUNCEMENT
Ladies and gentlemen, we have a passenger on board who has an extreme allergic reaction to peanuts, so for his safety we must ask you not to open any bags of peanuts or products containing peanuts.  If you have just purchased, on this plane, a bag of peanuts or products containing peanuts, you WILL, I repeat, you WILL not get reimbursed.  Thank you and enjoy our wonderful peanuts.

FRANCOIS
((looking at his bag of peanuts, then shoving one in his mouth))
Oops.

JEAN
Damn it, I had just fallen asleep.  Stupid announcement.  
((looks over at Francois and sees the peanuts))
Are you nuts?  You can’t eat those!
((grabs the bag of peanuts, opens his window, and throws it out))

FRANCOIS
Oh c’mon, as if it’s going to do anything...
In the background, we hear a passenger screaming and yell, “oh my god, he’s stopped breathing.  Help!”

FRANCOIS (CONT’D)
Shit, I think that’s the peanuts guy.

JEAN
See?  I told you you couldn’t eat those nuts.  Always something, with you.

FRANCOIS
Hey, it’s not my fault, they should have had the announcement before I opened my bag.

JEAN
Yeah, you’re right, then they wouldn’t have woken me up...
((tries to get in a comfortable position))
Alright, I’m gonna get back to it, I think

FRANCOIS
Okeydokey, goodnight.
Jean falls asleep again very quickly while Francois seems bored.  He taps his fingers, looks around, then takes out a book and starts reading.  A few moments later, two flight attendant arrive...

JOHNSON
Sir, may we have a word with you?

FRANCOIS
((no idea what it could be about))
Sure.

JOHNSON
I’m Flight Attendant Johnson, and this is deputy Flight Attendant Brown.  We just have a few questions we’d like to ask you, if you don’t mind?
Flight Attendant Brown scuffs in disgust.  Francois is surprised but doesn’t pay much attention to it.

FRANCOIS
Sure, shoot..,

BROWN
Yeah, I’m sure you’d love to do that, you psychopath.

FRANCOIS
I’m sorry?

JOHNSON
((to Brown))
Stop it, now!
((to Francois))
Don’t mind him, he’s had a rough flight.
Jean wakes up then, angrier than ever.

JEAN
A rough flight?  We haven’t even taken off yet, and I’ve already been woken up twice.  Now, what’s going on?

FRANCOIS
This is special Flight Attendant Johnson, and her deputy Brown.  They want to ask me a few questions.

JEAN
Oh yeah, what about?  Coz if it’s a customer satisfaction questionnaire, I can tell you this customer (points to himself) is highly unsatisfied!

BROWN
Sir, keep your voice low, some passengers are trying to sleep-

JEAN
My god, Francois, he’s mocking me!

JOHNSON
Brown, that’s enough.  Now, 
((turning to Francois again))
If you don’t mind, Sir, let’s start with the questions?

FRANCOIS
Sure.

JOHNSON
Now, di-

BROWN
((interrupts Johnson in mid-sentence))
Did you kill Peanuts Guy, you son of a bitch?

JEAN
Don’t answer that, Francois!
((turns to Brown))
Who the hell do you think you are?  What authority do you have?  Do you know who you’re talking to?  Do you know who this is?  Francois!  This is Francois!  Now, go get me a glass of water, flight attendant
Jean hands out his glass to Brown, who takes it, fuming with anger.

BROWN
I may be a flight attendant, but I am also responsible for security on board.
((points to a pink sticker saying security))
And when you “Francois” brutally murdered Peanuts Guy, that was a breach of security.  On my plane.  
((he edges closer to Jean))
And for that, I promise you, Francois will go down.  Push me a bit more, and you’ll go down with him

JEAN
Down, down, but we’re still on the ground... Now go get me my water!
Reluctantly, Brown goes get water for Jean

FRANCOIS
((to Johnson))
Ma’am, you have to listen to me, it was all an accident.  I didn’t eve-
((gets interrupted by Jean))

JEAN
Francois, don’t say another word.
Brown returns with the water, in the pro
cess of handing the glass to Jean, he pretends to trip and spills the glass all over Jean
		.

Breaking News||Poem.text:
She spurts the words out,
they come, they clout,
I wobble, I doubt,
like a lamb in front of the wolf
but I'm a child in front of my mother,
so something's ticking;
a gush of air erupts from my chest,
gobbles up my throat,
I freak,
I breathe a long sigh out,
like an ex-smoker with a new first drag,
my legs quaver,
my legs are numb,
my legs feel like a hundred pounds,
and my ears are bombarded by a cluster of sounds
because my mother is screaming
and my brother is trying to calm her
and the TV is attempting to brainwash us
and my mind is losing control
and the birds are karaoking some shitty song
and I certainly don't feel strong,
I feel tiny and scared

Sometimes…||Poem.text:
Sometimes for no reason, when I’m by myself at night, fear swells up inside of me and I feel the desperate need to crawl into my couch in a fetus position with my Yorkshire held tight against my chest.  Sometimes...

Then at other times, frustration swells up inside of me because my baby is crying, and I’m holding him in my arms and his tiny hands are firmly clutching a hand or two of mine and I feel his tiny tears rolling down his cheeks and trickling down onto my shoulders and I’m singing -- off key -- children’s songs, disheartened .  Sometimes...

Occasionally anger overtakes as I’m pacing around our two-room apartment, cell phone in hand to check the time every minute or so and to be ready to jump at any incoming call or SMS, and my mind is imagining extreme scenarios of what Emilia could be doing while out in bars and how things will ensue once she comes home.  Sometimes...

Every so often I feel tired and impatient and basically every negative noun, adverb, or adjective possible, towards my family because of their lack of depth, their lies, and I‘m exasperated because I know they mean well but I feel like their whole existence is rotten.  Sometimes...

Sometimes, shit happens.  Then, it means I have to change Leo’s diapers.  Sometimes...
